headline: Live transfer rumors, news, updates on deadline day
description: We bring you the latest news, rumors, done deals and reaction throughout Europe's transfer deadline day, up to the Premier League window closing at 6 p.m. ET.

headline: Harvey Elliott leaves Liverpool on loan for Valencia
description: Liverpool midfielder Harvey Elliott has joined Spanish side Valencia on a season-long loan.

headline: Man City agree to record-equaling £125m deal with Chelsea for Enzo Fernández - sources
description: Manchester City have agreed to a Premier League record-equaling £125 million ($169m) deal with Chelsea for Enzo Fernández, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Gabriel Jesus took pay cut for 'dream' Barcelona transfer from Arsenal
description: Gabriel Jesus said he took a pay cut to ensure he landed his "dream" transfer after signing for Barcelona from Arsenal on Tuesday.

headline: Ogden: Man Utd failing to sign a defender is a 'dereliction of duty'
description: Ogden: Man Utd failing to sign a defender is a 'dereliction of duty'

headline: Chelsea's €45m Lamine Camara bid rejected amid Enzo Fernández talks - sources
description: Chelsea have made a €45 million bid for Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara amid ongoing talks with Manchester City over the possible departure of Enzo Fernández, sources have told ESPN.
